trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Vijayapura — MC No. 217/2021
case_name: Akshata W/O Gurulingayya Vastrad vs Gurulingayya S/O Mahadevayya Vastrad
facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife of respondent. Marriage solemnized on 27.02.2015. Petitioner subjected to harassment and thrown out of matrimonial home. She is residing in parental home with baby girl. Respondent neglected them. Petitioner initiated proceedings under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. for maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: Inconvenience of parties cannot be the sole criteria for dismissing a petition.
legal_principles.held: It is further emphasized that the respondent/husband has obtained employment on compassionate ground and would apprehend losing of the job as he has already exhausted all available leaves. It is further emphasized that the inconvenience of parties cannot be the sole criteria unless it is shown that injustice would be caused to the parties.
cited_cases: SMT.H.K.SUMA & ANOTHER Vs. M.SANTOSH, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to attend proceedings does not necessarily mean the petition should be dismissed.
legal_principles.held: The travelling from Bagalkot to Vijayapura apart from involving expenditure also would cause hardship as she would not be able to attend the case effectively.

outcome.final_order: Petition allowed and case transferred to Principal Judge, Family Court, Bagalkot.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case in family court
